lap-dat-dieu-hoa.description: Wall-mounted and ceiling cassette air conditioner installation for brand and marketplace orders: scope of work, reference parts prices and warranty.
lap-dat-dieu-hoa.lead: Wall-mounted and ceiling cassette units for brand, marketplace and retail orders: site survey, tidy pipe runs, vacuuming and a test run before sign-off.
lap-dat-dieu-hoa.card: Wall-mounted and ceiling cassette units: site survey, vacuuming and a test run before sign-off.

wall.title: Wall-mounted air conditioners
wall.body: Indoor unit on the wall, outdoor unit outside on a bracket or on the roof.

ceiling.title: Ceiling cassette air conditioners
ceiling.body: Indoor unit built into the ceiling; the ceiling and pipe route are surveyed first.

lap-dat-dieu-hoa.scopeTitle: What the technician does on site

scope.survey: Survey the site and agree with the customer where the indoor and outdoor units and the pipe run go.
scope.mount: Hang the indoor unit with enough clearance below the ceiling for return air; place the outdoor unit somewhere ventilated and sheltered, with room to shed heat.
scope.pipe: Run the copper pipe, power cable and drain pipe neatly, with as few joints and bends as possible and enough fall on the drain.
scope.vacuum: Vacuum the pipework before opening the refrigerant valves.
scope.power: Connect power to a dedicated circuit breaker with correctly sized cable.
scope.test: Test-run the unit and check cooling, water leaks, gas leaks and noise; show the customer how to use it and sign off with photos.

included.labor: Labour to install the indoor and outdoor units within the standard scope
included.vacuum: Vacuuming and a gas leak check
included.test: A test run and a handover to the customer
included.cleanup: Cleaning up the work area before handover

excluded.materials: Extra parts: insulated copper pipe, power cable, drain pipe and brackets when more are needed
excluded.site: Difficult positions, such as working at height or without safe access: agreed with the customer before work starts
excluded.product: Product or component faults: covered by the manufacturer's warranty

vacuum.q: Why does the pipework need to be vacuumed?
vacuum.a: Vacuuming removes air and moisture from the pipes, prevents refrigerant blockages and helps the compressor last longer. Skip it and the unit tends to lose cooling after a while.

pipe.q: Why shouldn't the pipe run be too short or have sharp bends?
pipe.a: Pipes that are too short, sharply bent or joined in many places make the unit cool poorly, use more power and leak refrigerant more easily. The minimum length depends on each brand's guidelines.

materials.a: The customer and the technician agree on site using the reference parts prices, and the customer pays the technician directly.

prepare.q: What should the customer prepare before the technician arrives?
prepare.a: A power supply, clear access and a safe work area, plus someone on hand to check and sign off the work when it is done.

warranty.q: How long is the installation warranty?
warranty.a: The warranty period depends on the type of service and is set out in the warranty policy.

lap-dat-dien-may.description: Installation of washing machines, wall-mounted TVs, refrigerators and other appliances for brand and marketplace orders.
lap-dat-dien-may.lead: Washing machines, dryers, refrigerators, wall-mounted TVs and kitchen appliances: securely installed, safely connected, test-run and explained to the customer.
lap-dat-dien-may.card: Washing machines, dryers, refrigerators, wall-mounted TVs, induction hobs, cooker hoods, water purifiers and water heaters.

laundry.title: Washing machines and dryers
laundry.body: Remove the transit bolts, level the feet, connect the water supply and drain, and fit the earth wire.

fridge.title: Refrigerators
fridge.body: Level the unit, leave space for heat to escape, and check the power supply and earthing.

tv.title: Wall-mounted TVs
tv.body: Drill the wall, fit a fixed, tilting or swivel bracket, connect to the network and set the viewing angle.

kitchen.title: Induction hobs and cooker hoods
kitchen.body: Connect a power supply rated for the appliance, secure it firmly and test-run it.

water.title: Water purifiers and water heaters
water.body: Connect the water lines, check for leaks, and wire and earth the unit safely.

lap-dat-dien-may.scopeTitle: What the technician does on site

scope.check: Check the position, power supply, water supply and drain before starting.
scope.fix: Install, level and secure the appliance firmly.
scope.connect: Connect power and water to the brand's guidelines; fit an earth wire on appliances that use water.
scope.test: Test-run the appliance, show the customer how to use it and sign off with photos.

included.labor: Labour to install and connect within the standard scope
included.test: A test run and a handover to the customer
included.cleanup: Cleaning up the work area before handover

excluded.materials: Extra parts: supply and drain hose extensions, power cable and brackets when more are needed
excluded.site: Difficult positions: agreed with the customer before work starts
excluded.product: Product or component faults: covered by the manufacturer's warranty

grounding.q: Why does a washing machine need an earth wire?
grounding.a: A washing machine uses water and electricity in a damp environment. Without an earth wire, the casing can become live and give an electric shock.

bolts.q: Do the transit bolts need to come out when installing a washing machine?
bolts.a: Yes. The bolts that hold the drum in transit must be removed before the machine is plugged in; left in place, they make the machine shake violently and damage the drum suspension.

tv.q: What is needed to wall-mount a TV?
tv.a: Pick a load-bearing wall near a power socket and a network point. The technician checks the wall and advises on the bracket type before drilling.

warranty.q: How long is the installation warranty?
warranty.a: The warranty period depends on the type of service and is set out in the warranty policy.

bao-tri-dinh-ky.description: Scheduled air conditioner maintenance for store chains and offices: cleaning, checks against an agreed list and photo records of each unit.
bao-tri-dinh-ky.lead: Scheduled cleaning and checks of air conditioners for store chains and offices, with the condition of every unit recorded in photos.
bao-tri-dinh-ky.card: Scheduled air conditioner cleaning and checks for store chains and offices, with photo records.

ac.title: Wall-mounted and ceiling cassette air conditioners
ac.body: Clean the indoor unit, outdoor unit and filters; check refrigerant pressure, fans, capacitors and the power supply.

bao-tri-dinh-ky.scopeIntro: Scheduled maintenance helps equipment last longer, catches faults early and keeps cooling performance up.

scope.plan: Agree the list of sites, units and maintenance frequency in the contract.
scope.schedule: Schedule maintenance rounds for each site.
scope.service: The technician cleans and checks against the list and records the condition of each unit in photos.
scope.settle: Reconcile per maintenance round, with any extra work listed separately.

included.clean: Cleaning of the indoor unit, outdoor unit and filters
included.check: Checks of refrigerant pressure, fans, capacitors and the power supply
included.record: Photo records of every unit's condition

excluded.parts: Part replacement, refrigerant top-ups and repairs: outside the scheduled visit
excluded.product: Component faults still under the manufacturer's warranty: covered by that warranty

frequency.q: How often should an air conditioner be cleaned?
frequency.a: It depends on usage and the environment. Filters should be cleaned regularly; full cleaning of the indoor and outdoor units follows the schedule agreed in the contract.

gas.q: Does scheduled maintenance include a refrigerant top-up?
gas.a: Each visit checks the refrigerant pressure. A top-up or part replacement is extra work, outside the scheduled visit.

chains.q: Can a chain with sites in many provinces use the service?
chains.a: The list of sites is checked against the technician network before the contract is signed.

warranty.a: The warranty period depends on the type of service and is set out in the warranty policy.

cta.body: Send the list of sites, the number of units and how often you want them serviced. The sales team will propose a schedule and a quote.

lap-dat-robot-hut-bui.lead: Place the charging dock, connect the app, run the first home mapping and show the customer how to use their robot vacuum.
lap-dat-robot-hut-bui.card: Dock placement, Wi-Fi and app connection, first home mapping and a handover to the customer.

robot.title: Robot vacuums and mops
robot.body: Models controlled through a smartphone app.

lap-dat-robot-hut-bui.scopeTitle: What the technician does during installation

scope.dock: Choose an open spot for the charging dock near a power socket, with clear space in front.
scope.app: Connect the robot to Wi-Fi and to the brand's app on the customer's phone.
scope.map: Run the first mapping of the home and set no-go zones and a cleaning schedule.
scope.handover: Show the customer how to clean the brushes, dust bin and mop, and how to update the software.

included.setup: Dock placement, app connection and first mapping
included.guide: A handover on use and basic upkeep

excluded.network: Installing or repairing the home Wi-Fi network
excluded.product: Product or component faults: covered by the manufacturer's warranty

wifi.q: What Wi-Fi does the robot need?
wifi.a: The robot needs a stable Wi-Fi signal at the dock and in the rooms it cleans. The technician checks the connection during setup; adding network equipment is outside the service scope.

account.q: Whose name should the app account be in?
account.a: The account is best kept in the customer's name, with the customer signing in on their own phone.

warranty.q: How long is the installation warranty?
warranty.a: The warranty period depends on the type of service and is set out in the warranty policy.
